title: Main story quests (packs/<game>/<faction>/story-quests.json)
description: DRAFT. One record per Hero/Episode quest. Ids are sq:<game id> (M6). Order is the 'next' chain (validated: one start, one end, no cycles). Replaces story.json, story-40-45.json, QUESTS, QUEST_STEPS, QUEST_LOC, STORY_UNLOCKS, UNLOCK_GATE.

id.description: sq:<game id> (M6). The English name stays the save key.

key.description: Save key = the English quest name (state.quest, state.qsteps, state.qsub, storyEnd). Permanent even if the game renames the quest.

next.description: Next story quest id; null only on the last quest of the chain.

end.description: Only on the last covered quest: where the data ends (STORY_END).

next.description: The next story quest in the game, past the guide's cap (not a record): its name, for the end-of-story text.

nextLv.description: The level the next story quest unlocks at.

unlocks.description: What turning it in unlocks that the guide tracks (STORY_UNLOCKS) and the milestone that covers it (UNLOCK_GATE). milestone is optional: an unlock before the first milestone (e.g. Prepare to Escape) has none.

wraps.description: The Ascension quest this quest's objective completes (4 records). Basis for derived Ascension completion.

levelsUp.description: 0.6 P19, 0.8 P15 (owner, 2026-10-17, owner-ok-autolevel; #401): turning it in at Lv from gives exactly a full level (100% EXP), Lv from → from + 1. from is the level it is turned in at (sourced, not the recommended lv: docs/research/2026-10-research-401-levels.md). Ticking it in the app at Lv from raises the level by one; unticking or Undo at Lv from + 1 lowers it back; at any other level nothing changes. A quest that gives less than a full level (e.g. 50%) has no levelsUp. Only with a source whose fields name levelsUp (owner screen or a game-database field; the build checks it).

from.description: The level the quest is turned in at.

inCap.description: false for records past the Lv 45 scope (Waiting for the Next Journey): they keep the chain complete but never reach Next up.
